title: Bounded finite-module models of a successor quotient
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme, (A,I) an adic coefficient datum, and M an arbitrary derived object over its actual completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Suppose isomorphisms phi identify the constant finite quotient rings with the actual ones and commute with their consecutive maps and completed scalar projections. Let V be an etale chart and a<=b. If the residue reduction and the nth reduction have etale-local constant finite-projective complex models in [a,b], in the precise predicate [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data], then there is an etale covering sieve T of V such that on every W->V in T the (n+1)st reduction has a constant complex P of finite A/I^(n+2)-modules, with terms zero outside [a,b], and the specified actual derived restriction isomorphism. The terms of P need not be projective. The choice can satisfy Nonempty W or P=0, using P=0 on empty charts. No completeness or compatible trivializations are assumed.

source.place: Tags 094I (lemma-bounded, coefficient ideal filtration) and 094G (lemma-locally-constant); proetale.tex Tag 09C2 (lemma-describe-constructible-complexes)

proof.text: The coefficient-filtration cohomology theorem gives vanishing of the actual successor cohomology outside [a,b] and finite etale-local models of each individual cohomology sheaf.

The quotient ring is finite by the adic datum. Apply finiteCoefficient_etale_bounded_models to that actual coefficient ring sheaf, its specified comparison phi_(n+1), and the actual successor reduction. This gives bounded finite-module complex models on nonempty charts of a covering sieve.

On an empty chart every object of its localized proetale site is empty, so the empty-cover sheaf axiom makes every module sheaf zero. The canonical cochain representative shows every derived object there is zero. Choose the zero algebraic complex; its terms are finite, it satisfies both strict bounds, and the unique zero-object isomorphism gives the specified restriction model. This establishes the empty-chart alternative.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteQuotient_finiteModule_models_succ
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hresidue : FinitePerfectModelsOn X d φ M 0 V a b) (n : ℕ)
    (hprevious : FinitePerfectModelsOn X d φ M n V a b) :
    ∃ T : Sieve V, T ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology V ∧
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V), T g →
        ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1))) ℤ,
          P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
          (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1)) (P.X i)) ∧
          Nonempty
          (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d (n + 1))
              ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicQuotientReduction X d (n + 1)).obj M) ≅
            ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d (n + 1))
              ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (φ (n + 1))).obj
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X _ P)))) ∧
          (Nonempty W.left ∨ IsZero P)
